caveat: These are proposed studies derived from the current Method 1 synthesis; they are hypotheses and study designs for future work, not accepted claims, and not tied to catalogued evidence. Method 1's confidence scale is internal and not comparable across methods.
policy: grounded in local synthesis; no invented titles/DOIs/numeric findings/source IDs; proposed data named as future data; claim IDs only in provenance

proposals.title: A causal test of whether AGN feedback suppresses star formation
proposals.question: At fixed stellar mass and environment, do AGN-hosting galaxies show a measurable star-formation deficit attributable to feedback energy, rather than to shared mass/environment?
already_show: The source basis is non-committal on a direct causal link: its assembled evidence for internal AGN regulation neither confirms nor refutes it.
It does record a mechanism — kinetic-mode jets and outflows mechanically interacting with the surrounding medium.
It reports AGN-linked shutdown at cosmic noon as a discussed rapid channel, and hot-halo heating support mainly from simulations.
proposals.unknown: Whether a matched population shows a star-formation deficit tied to AGN energy, and which gas phase (molecular reservoir vs replenishing inflow) actually responds.
data_plan: SDSS-MaNGA or MUSE — spatially resolved star-formation histories and gas kinematics around the AGN (the response).
ALMA CO — molecular gas mass and depletion time (the fuel).
Chandra/XMM-Newton — X-ray AGN power (the energy budget).
VLA/LOFAR — jet power and duty cycle (the kinetic channel).
proposals.test: Compare resolved SF suppression and molecular gas content between mass-, redshift-, and morphology-matched AGN and non-AGN control samples, as a function of AGN power and mode.
proposals.decision: A calibrated star-formation deficit (or its absence) at fixed mass/environment, with an energy budget sufficient (or not) to drive it — promoting or bounding the causal claim.
proposals.provenance: Provenance: source basis claim 2929 (non-committal/unverified); kinetic mode 2915; rapid-quenching channel 2913.

proposals.title: Where internal (mass-driven) quenching separates from environmental quenching
proposals.question: At fixed stellar mass, does local environment add a measurable quenching excess beyond internal processes, and in which mass/redshift regime do the two channels separate versus stay degenerate?
already_show: The source basis reports quenching as jointly regulated by internal and environment-linked processes.
It treats their separability and relative priority as sample-, redshift-, and definition-dependent (a debated point).
A minority of its evidence supports a clean separation while most is inconclusive.
proposals.unknown: Which combination of mass, redshift, and environment makes the channels separable, and whether satellite-versus-central status is the controlling variable.
data_plan: SDSS/GAMA — low-redshift group/cluster environment and quenched fractions.
COSMOS/CANDELS + JWST — environment at cosmic noon.
DESI — large mass/redshift-matched parent samples (the denominator).
Euclid/Rubin (LSST) — wide-area environment and weak-lensing halo mass.
proposals.test: Hold stellar mass fixed and vary environment (and vice versa); measure the environmental quenching excess at fixed mass across redshift.
proposals.decision: A separation map: the mass/redshift/environment regime where an environmental quenching excess is (or is not) detectable at fixed mass.
proposals.provenance: Provenance: source basis claim 2931 (debated); satellite quenching 2934; environment-morphology 2932.

proposals.title: An observed heating-versus-cooling balance for maintenance quenching
proposals.question: In massive halos, does AGN heating balance radiative cooling closely and frequently enough to maintain quiescence when measured observationally, not just in simulations?
already_show: The source basis records maintenance heating as reported but model/simulation-dependent.
Its support comes chiefly from simulations rather than a measured prevalence.
Direct observational backing (X-ray cavities, hot-halo balance) is sparse in its evidence set.
proposals.unknown: The observed frequency and time-averaged sufficiency of heating versus cooling across a mass-selected population — not just individual cavity systems.
data_plan: Chandra — X-ray cavities and their mechanical power.
XMM-Newton/eROSITA — hot-halo thermodynamics and cooling luminosity.
VLA/LOFAR — radio-mode AGN duty cycle.
IllustrisTNG/HORIZON-AGN-style simulations — forward-modeled predictions to test against, labeled as simulations.
proposals.test: Measure cavity/heating power versus cooling luminosity across a mass-selected sample; compare the observed balance and duty cycle to the simulation predictions.
proposals.decision: An observed bound on how often heating balances cooling — converting the model expectation into a measured prevalence, or refuting it.

proposals.title: A prioritized evidence-gap map for the narrative-only sections
proposals.question: Which parts of the galaxy-evolution narrative currently carry no direct evidence in the method basis, and in what order should named surveys ground them?
already_show: The source basis directly evidences only a small part of its own narrative — coverage concentrates on AGN feedback and quenching.
Dark-matter-halo connections, gas supply, environment, chemical enrichment, and the high-redshift/reionization frontier are carried as narrative without attached evidence.
Only two of its nine sections carry any directly evidenced statement.
proposals.unknown: Which under-evidenced section is most tractable to ground first, and the expected evidence yield of each candidate survey per section.
data_plan: DESI — spectroscopy for gas, metallicity, and environment.
SDSS legacy — statistical baselines.
Euclid/Rubin — scale and large-scale structure.
JWST — the high-redshift/reionization frontier.
proposals.test: Score each thematic section by current evidential support and by the estimated yield of each candidate survey; produce a ranked observational to-do list.
proposals.decision: A reusable evidence-gap ranking that turns narrative-only sections into a concrete data-collection order.
proposals.provenance: Provenance: source basis per-section coverage (two of nine sections directly evidenced).

proposals.title: Robustness of conclusions to evidence accounting (methods appendix)
proposals.question: Do the method's qualitative conclusions change when support is counted by distinct study rather than by record, and when incompletely catalogued references are resolved?
already_show: The method basis stores evidence as records that can repeat a study — its evidenced claims show 43 records collapsing to 26 distinct studies.
Several references are catalogued only as identifiers, without resolved titles or metadata.
A pile of records can therefore overstate independent support.
proposals.unknown: Whether any claim's confidence level shifts under distinct-study counting, and how much interpretation depends on the unresolved references.
data_plan: The method's existing literature corpus (no new observations).
NASA ADS / local bibliography — metadata resolution only, explicitly not observational evidence.
proposals.test: Recompute per-claim support on a distinct-study basis, resolve the identifier-only references, and compare to the record-based tally.
proposals.decision: A methods-appendix result on whether conclusions are stable against evidence-accounting choices, plus a corrected distinct-study support level per claim.
proposals.provenance: Provenance: source basis evidence tables (record-versus-study counts; identifier-only references).

proposals.title: Pre-registered acceptance criteria for AGN-feedback conclusions (methods appendix)
proposals.question: What explicit observational thresholds would justify promoting an AGN-feedback statement from tentative to established?
already_show: The method basis places its AGN-feedback statements below an accepted level — one non-committal, one simulation-reported.
It promotes or demotes them by qualitative judgement rather than by stated criteria.
proposals.unknown: The quantitative thresholds — independent-study support, observation-versus-simulation mix, effect size and consistency — that should gate promotion.
data_plan: The combined observational programs above (RP-1/RP-2/RP-3 measurements) as the inputs a promotion decision would draw on — proposed evidence to gather.
NASA ADS / local corpus — independent-study counting only.
proposals.test: Specify thresholds and apply them retrospectively to the current AGN-feedback statements to see which would promote, hold, or demote.
proposals.decision: A reproducible acceptance rule set that other syntheses could adopt, reducing subjective confidence judgements.
proposals.provenance: Provenance: source basis AGN feedback & quenching section (statements 2929 non-committal, 2946 reported).
